items.statement: Patients in practices with dashboard version 2 are more likely to complete both kidney tests between March and September 2026 than patients in practices still on version 1, after adjustment for practice baseline.
items.rationale: Uses the concurrent comparison the schedule provides; the patient list is the feature most likely to act (claim c2).

items.statement: The effect is concentrated in practices that open the patient list at least monthly.
items.rationale: List views precede improvement in usage logs (claim c4).
items.risks: Use is not randomised; a dose-response is descriptive.

items.statement: Version 2 increases duplicate kidney testing in patients tested in hospital clinics.
items.risks: Hospital results may be incompletely linked.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected, h2 and h3 as pre-specified secondary and balancing questions.
